attributes.action: Child Maintenance Service to take essential living costs into account
attributes.additional_details:
At present, CMS calculations are based on gross income, with limited consideration of a paying parent’s essential household expenditure costs such as mortgage/rent, utility bills and other basic household cost. These significantly reduce the income actually available to meet a maintenance liability.

I recognise Child maintenance is vital. However, a more sustainable system should take into account whether the paying parent can meet their own basic living costs after paying maintenance.
attributes.background: I petition the Government to reform CMS calculations so paying parents’ essential costs, including mortgage/rent, council tax and utilities, are considered. Child maintenance should remain protected, while assessments should also reflect the parent’s genuine ability to pay fairly and realistically.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: Review CMS Payments To Ensure Fairness For Paying Parents and Children https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/770444
